title: Finalizer endpoint configuration
statement: Fix a finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, a mode bit, and Boolean words $x$, $a$, and $c$. Embed the finalizer configuration on input $x$ in state $5$, with input head at position $1$, argument tape storing $a$ in emit mode and $c$ in install mode, capture tape blank, both work heads at the origin, and output $c$ in emit mode and empty in install mode, into the call machine's tape layout. The resulting configuration is the canonical configuration on input $x$ in the exit state, with the first work tape storing $a$ in emit mode and $c$ in install mode, every other work tape blank, all work heads at the origin, and the same mode-dependent output.
replaced:
For every mode, input, argument word $a$, and capture word $c$: relocating the
finalizer's final configuration through the pair layout equals the canonical seam in the
exit control state whose first work tape holds $c$ in install mode and $a$ in emit mode,
all other tapes blank, all heads at their origins, with output $c$ in emit mode and
empty otherwise.
